howTo: Ask each prompt in a new conversation of the host, save the final answer as text, then run: node scripts/check-answer.mjs --case <id> --answer <file> [--board <board.json>]. For E1 save the board response the answer used (or fetch the same parameters once) and pass it with --board. Free tests only: fake keys, isolated target folders, no supplier sign-up, top-up or paid request. scripts/run-answer-evals.mjs runs every case automatically with the local Codex CLI in empty test folders, replays the board request the agent made and checks each final answer.
